title: Exemptions.
bodyText: The following are exempt from military duty: all persons exempted from military duty under the laws of the United States, all judges of the several courts, and the members of the legislature.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: Reference to "magistrates" following "judges", deleted as unnecessary in view of L 1970, c 188.

bodyHtml:
§121-2  Exemptions.  The following are exempt from military duty:  all persons exempted from military duty under the laws of the United States, all judges of the several courts, and the members of the legislature. [L 1967, c 196, pt of §1; HRS §121-2]

 

Revision Note

 

  Reference to "magistrates" following "judges", deleted as unnecessary in view of L 1970, c 188.
